review_evidence: README identifies the source as a formalization of Nederpelt and Geuvers, Type Theory and Formal Proof, covering untyped, simply typed, second-order, and dependent type systems.

Direct inspection of the seven Lean files found inductive syntax and typing judgements plus dozens of theorems/lemmas on alpha/beta equivalence, substitution, normalization, typing, and related metatheory.
The complete root lakefile.lean contains only Lake package/library options and dependency declarations for batteries, aesop, mathlib, calcify, and doc-gen4.

rules.content_invariant: The selected file contains only Lake package, target, option, and dependency configuration; it owns no type-theory definition, judgement, theorem, proof, example, or semantic interface.
evidence: Complete inspection of lakefile.lean found import/open Lake DSL, package/lean_lib declarations, an autoImplicit option, and dependency declarations only.
rules.rationale: Exclude the exact root Lake package/dependency configuration while retaining every type-theory source module and import root.

summary: Retain the textbook type-theory formalization; exclude only the root Lake dependency/build configuration.
